studies.title: Coordinates of latitude and longitude
studies.caption: Ptolemy's Geography lists some 8,000 places by latitude and longitude, so that a map can be redrawn by anyone from the numbers alone.
studies.prompt: Over-shoulder view of a scholar in Roman Alexandria about150CE plotting points with a straightedge and dividers on a papyrus sheet with a simple geographic grid; rolled manuscripts nearby. Unreadable tiny handwritten marks, not Arabic numerals, no modern printed atlas or blue globe.
